concept.title: Single Router vs Mesh Wi-Fi
concept.shortdesc: Home networks can use a single router or a mesh Wi Fi system to provide wireless coverage.

section.title: Single Router Network
section.p: A single-router network uses one to provide wired and wireless connectivity.
This deployment is suitable for small homes and areas with good signal coverage.

section.title: Mesh Wi Fi Network
section.p: A mesh network uses multiple devices to provide Wi Fi coverage across a larger area.
In this guide, the can use one or more devices to extend wireless coverage.

ul.li: A single router uses one Wi Fi source.
A mesh system uses multiple Wi Fi nodes.
A mesh system can improve coverage in larger homes.
A single router is simpler to deploy and manage.

section.title: Advanced Information
section.p: Mesh nodes communicate with each other to exchange network traffic and maintain wireless coverage across the deployment.
Depending on the deployment, the mesh system can use wired or wireless backhaul connections.
